messages:
maria: opened PR #4086 to add post-incident notes and the status page link. small changes: known-issue blurb + workaround steps. requesting reviews from @kevin and @linda. can we aim to merge before the next deploy window?
kevin: on it. quick read now. one question — linkcheck is flaky with the statuspage redirect last time. did you run the link checker locally? :eyes:
mar ia: ran mkdocs linkcheck once, it passed, but GH Actions preview failed. I pushed a tiny change that adds an explicit absolute URL instead of relative anchor to avoid the redirect.
sam: can you paste the failing output from CI? that helps debug if it's a redirect vs 404.
maria: ci-bot posted this earlier: 

ci-bot: "linkcheck: WARN  -  External link 'https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-03-19' gave a 302 and then 404 on follow-up (http://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-03-19)"

maria: so looks like statuspage returns a 302->internal host that isn't reachable from GH Actions. switching to the canonical https URL should fix.
linda: also please add a small workaround snippet for customers who hit the stale token issue (reported in the incident). something like: 

> Workaround: rotate the API key in Console -> API keys, then restart the client to pick up the new token. If you can't rotate, use the fallback endpoint `https://api.redwood.example/v1/fallback` for reads only.

kevin: +1 on the workaround text. Can you add a short note under "Known limitations" that we might have transient 401s for up to 5 minutes? avoids confusing users.
maria: added both. pushed another commit. docs-preview-bot should post a new preview shortly.
docs-preview-bot: Preview available: https://deploy-preview-4086--docs.redwood.example/ (expires in 24 hours) :rocket:
kevin: preview looks good to me, content reads well. link to status page is canonical and not redirected. I left one tiny nit about code formatting.
mar ia: fixed the formatting nit (changed inline code to fenced block for the curl sample). pushed.
ci-bot: GH Actions — docs-build: succeeded; linkcheck: failed (1 broken external link). Details: 
 - /users/migration-guide.html#legacy-tokens -> https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-03-19 (302 -> 404)

maria: hm this is still failing because the migration guide link points to the old path. I updated the anomaly to point to https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-03-19/summary (new path). pushing fix now.
oliver: if CI keeps failing due to external statuspage rules, we can add to .linkcheck-ignore for the short term with a comment referencing the incident. but prefer fixing the URLs.
sam: agree — prefer correct URLs. but if we need to merge hotfix immediately and CI is blocking, we can get an exception from infra to bypass linkcheck for this PR and follow up with a cleanup PR.
linda: i'm running out of time today; if @kevin approves, please merge and cherry-pick to `release/2026-03` branch. add a short changelog line: "docs: add incident follow-up and workaround (incident 2026-03-19)" and announce in #incidents. :shipit:
kevin: approved. I'll wait 2m for any last comments. if none, merge and do the cherry-pick.
maria: merging now. running `git cherry-pick -x -m 1 origin/main` into `release/2026-03` after merge. pinging infra if the linkcheck exception is needed.
ci-bot: Merge detected: PR #4086 merged by maria. Docs deploy queued.
docs-preview-bot: Production docs deploy started for commit 7c3a9f2.
mar ia: done — cherry-pick applied to release branch and pushed. posting an update in #incidents with the statuspage link and the workaround note.
sam: thanks all — quick follow-up: file a small parent ticket to audit other refs to /incidents/ and normalize paths. I'll take it.
kevin: filed ENG-1728 to sweep incident links. :+1:
maria: thanks team. closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
